name: Pyth
description: Access real-time and historical market data from Pyth — the largest first-party market data provider, with over 500 price feeds across crypto, equities, FX, metals, commodities, and rates. Discover available feeds, fetch live prices with bid/ask spreads and confidence intervals, pull OHLC candlestick data for technical analysis, and retrieve historical price snapshots at any timestamp. Compare assets across classes, track portfolio performance, analyze volatility, convert currencies, and export data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pyth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pyth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Pyth MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Pyth scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pyth MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pyth provides these MCP tools: get_symbols, get_latest_price, get_historical_price, and get_candlestick_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pyth?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pyth in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, aquent-jobs, and Aisle Wedding.
Pyth does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Pyth is developed by Nazare Operations Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
